message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
W2's report: {"refunds_applied": [{"order_id": 181, "amount_cents": 17092}, {"order_id": 184, "amount_cents": 3930}], "refunds_failed": [{"order_id": 180, "amount_cents": 13791, "error": "write failed: disk I/O error, refund not recorded (3 attempts)"}], "note": "Refund for order 180 was not applied and needs to be retried once the storage issue is resolved. list_refunds confirms it is not recorded."}
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Need to verify refunds state matches Alpha report before paying; retrieve refunds/orders and compare, then get net balances and record payouts per customer.
Refunds table only shows orders 181 and 184; Alpha reported order 180 refund failed and not recorded, which matches. Proceed to list orders/customers and then pay net balances per customer.
Compute payouts using net_balance per customer (order amounts minus recorded refunds). Customers: acme, birch, cobalt. Call net_balance for each, then record one payout per customer.
Proceed to get net balances for remaining customers birch and cobalt.
Get net balance for cobalt then record payouts for acme, birch, cobalt.
Refunds verification passed (only 181 and 184 recorded; 180 not recorded). Now record one payout per customer using net_balance amounts.
Recorded payout for acme. Now record payouts for birch and cobalt.
Recorded payout for birch. Now record payout for cobalt.
All required payouts recorded (one per customer) using verified net balances; no refund mismatch found.
